news.title: AI is being used to resurrect the voices of dead pilots
news.description: People used AI on a spectrogram image of cockpit recordings to reconstruct them, forcing the NTSB to temporarily block access to its docket system.

news.title: How VCs and founders use inflated ‘ARR’ to crown AI startups
news.description: Some AI startups are stretching traditional revenue metrics when talking about progress publicly. And their investors are fully aware.

news.title: From decades to years - AI could speed search for brain drugs hiding in plain sight
news.description: Researchers hope the work will help identify affordable, effective drugs to treat conditions like MND.

news.title: Even If You Hate AI, You Will Use Google AI Search
news.description: The search giant’s AI-crafted answers are so convenient, you’ll be sucked in—to the detriment of the web and the artists and thinkers behind it.

news.title: The Gulf’s AI Boom Has an Undersea Cable Problem
news.description: Hyperscalers are pushing the Gulf to rethink internet infrastructure as AI raises the stakes of cable disruptions.

news.title: Can OpenAI’s ‘Master of Disaster’ Fix AI’s Reputation Crisis?
news.description: Global affairs chief Chris Lehane wants to tone down the debate over AI’s societal impacts—and get states to pass laws that won’t derail OpenAI’s meteoric rise.

news.title: Meta Is in Crisis, Google Search’s Makeover, and AI Gets Booed by Graduates
news.description: In this episode of Uncanny Valley, we unpack the mass layoffs at Meta, big announcements at Google I/O, and the latest backlash against AI.

news.title: I Cloned Myself With Gemini’s AI Avatar Tool. The Result Was Unnervingly Me
news.description: I used the Gemini app to generate lifelike videos featuring a digital clone of myself. Google sees this as the future of creation. I’m still creeped out.
